source_proof.physical_source: Exact e339 public tree plus nine byte-identical published test/support files and two shared dispatcher fixtures with identifier-only namespace correction; each arm selects its exact published production owner through the frozen overlay.

common_fixture_namespace_adjustments.change: Two identifier renames; all string values and other bytes unchanged

profile_scope.sdk: official Model Context Protocol Go SDK, v1.6.1
profile_scope.order: A–B–B–A, two runs per arm in each of four profiles
profile_scope.fixture: same input, test source and oracle within each profile; Relay echo payloads are synthetic and pass through the real SDK transports and Relay; CMake profile uses a pinned trace through the real registered tool
profile_scope.memory: whole test process, including harness and runtime; private working set is resident bytes; sampled peaks are lower bounds at 5 ms interval; private commit is distinct from resident memory
profile_scope.latency: CMake sequences and nearest-rank quantiles retained; Relay original summary quantiles retained, individual call durations unavailable
profile_scope.invalid_values: Signed CMake cancel-to-return values are retained. No negative values were observed in the 32 cancellation rows of this campaign. Any negative observation is invalid as elapsed duration. Zero values at clock resolution are not evidence of instantaneous return. One CMake sampling point is a baseline, not a meaningful peak.
profile_scope.go: go1.27.4 windows/amd64; GOMAXPROCS=4; GOGC=100; offline module inputs

field_units.HeapAlloc: bytes allocated and still in use on the Go heap

cmake.newer_current_head_change: parse.go read-error priority at both line and byte limits, separately tested

relay.newer_current_head_change: sessionless initialize, bounded dispatch and terminal POST/GET HTTP 404, separately tested

guard.negative_control: intentional native-owner timeout retained as command exit 1; guard identifies expected outcome and complete closure
